review: Implements the actual round-117 follow-up request from Moss after canonical lookup returned unresolved dimensions. This is a reviewed current-run physical-model addition and metrology extension, with explicit reuse of current-run references, mass accounting, collision, escrow and shelter code. It is not historical skill inheritance or a recovered historical measurement. Finite natural branch source slots use fixed seed/source/slot geometry, density 600 and slenderness 15-70 solved from actual mass, without conditioning on shelter suitability. Withdrawn source slots are reserved before residual stock; surviving intact whole units are reconciled deterministically and ambiguous/altered fractional remnants remain unresolved. Known old represented dimensions and historical null observations remain unchanged. No stock, bark, sheets, lash length, certified tool, usable pole or personal mastery is granted. Basic whole-unit transfers preserve identity; partial consumption cannot resample or clone geometry. The new interface requires two personal learning rounds, paid inspection at 0.2, two-stage measurement at 0.3 each and two-stage actual allocated-load testing at 0.5 each. World-coordinate intervals are not independently calibrated SI measurements. A conservative minimum-section tapered-beam response includes self-weight, actual midpoint load, defects and moisture. Passes are specimen/span/condition bound, never batch or longer-span certificates; overloaded material retains damage or conserved fragments, surviving weights remain. The existing shelter adapter consumes personal intervals/load evidence and retains roofing, lash and factor-two proof. Its uniform support-capacity model conservatively requires a tested span of at least 1.8 for represented poles; no shorter-span result is extrapolated. Persistent operation records bind exact surviving quantities, layout, paid stages and remaining work. Energy/access pauses do not charge; cancellation, incompatible action or position, death and explicit resume retain paid history and release surviving escrow once. Completed work cannot restart. Shared understanding is driven by paid completed new evidence, not migration, learning or inspection; repeated renamed observations do not renew information rewards. Existing practice feedback still requires completed paid qualified evidence. Ten targeted regressions pass for retained actual branch identity, null pre-migration diagnostics, finite allocation, mass geometry, two-stage execution, serialization, escrow and resume, alias/partial/hidden/occluded rejection, transfer, separate individual learning/evidence, death, fracture, repeated feedback and changed resumed quantity. Types, lint, build and the selected browser check pass; all three final images were actually inspected, with overlapping labels and a misleading loaded-stage label repaired. Fixture weights and outcomes never enter formal actor state. Full unfiltered checks and identical 117-round world/event reconstruction are required before activation.
